I handled the two recording defects:**\n\n- *No timestamps*: nothing of the form `[HH:MM]` appears anywhere. I added a regex guard in the generator that fails the build if one ever does.\n- *Same-name speakers*: the confusable pair is 徐志远 / 吴志远. Entries attributed to either get the `（归属待核）` suffix; entries by 周丽娜, 吴雨桐, 刘晓雯 do not. I did not invent any 甲/乙 or department labels to disambiguate.\n\nEvery item's content is a verbatim substring of a transcript line — I verified this programmatically (a build-time trace check plus an independent re-read of the docx, which reported no errors). Where the transcript gave no time limit (吴志远's 责任分工梳理, 周丽娜's 发群里), 期限 is `未明确`; the other two carry 下周一 and 本周五.\n\nI also left `build_minutes.py` in the working directory — it regenerates both artifacts and re-runs the traceability checks. One environment note worth knowing: `python-docx` is installed under `/usr/bin/python3`, not the `ml` venv that `python3` resolves to on PATH, so I ran the script with the absolute interpreter path.",
